title: CollageAttack: Exploiting Cross-Modal Alignment Flaws in T2I Models through Spatial Text Composition
abstract: arXiv:2609.38253v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) models have substantially improved in language understanding, in-image text rendering, and visual composition, while their safety mechanisms do not always keep pace with these capabilities. This creates a cross-modal attack surface in which harmful semantics can remain inconspicuous in a serialized prompt yet emerge through image-level composition. We propose CollageAttack, an automated single-prompt black-box jailbreak that shifts semantic assembly into the image plane by combining context-relevant scenes, scene-grounded textual carriers, and spatially distributed text fragments. Experiments across multiple open-weight and commercial T2I models show that CollageAttack achieves attack success rates of up to 86.0%, outperforming the strongest baseline on the same model by 18.5 percentage points, while consistently producing more harmful outputs and preserving the source intent. translated_title: CollageAttack：通过空间文本组合利用文生图模型中的跨模态对齐缺陷
translated_abstract: 文生图（T2I）模型在语言理解、图像内文字渲染和视觉构图方面已取得显著进步，但其安全机制并不总是能与这些能力同步发展。这造成了一个跨模态攻击面：有害语义可以在序列化提示词中保持隐蔽，却通过图像层面的组合显现出来。我们提出了 CollageAttack，一种自动化的单提示词黑盒越狱攻击，它通过组合与上下文相关的场景、以场景为载体的文字元素以及空间分布的文本片段，将语义组装转移到图像平面上。在多个开源权重和商业 T2I 模型上的实验表明，CollageAttack 的攻击成功率高达 86.0%，在同一模型上比最强基线高出 18.5 个百分点，同时持续产生更有害的输出并保留原始意图。我们进一步发现，分布式文本（摘要在此处被截断）……
tldr: 提出 CollageAttack，一种利用文生图模型跨模态对齐缺陷的黑盒越狱攻击方法，通过将有害语义拆解为场景、文字载体和空间分布文本片段并在图像层面组合呈现，实现高达 86.0% 的攻击成功率，比最强基线高出 18.5 个百分点。
en_tdlr: CollageAttack is an automated single-prompt black-box jailbreak that exploits cross-modal alignment flaws in T2I models by shifting semantic assembly into the image plane—combining context-relevant scenes, scene-grounded textual carriers, and spatially distributed text fragments—achieving up to 86.0% attack success rate and outperforming the strongest baseline by 18.5 percentage points.
